name: professional-workshop-design
description:
Designs professional development workshops for workplace audiences with agendas, facilitator guides, activities, and measurable outcomes. Produces a complete workshop package for corporate trainers and facilitators -- distinct from academic workshop design.
Use when a trainer asks to design a professional workshop, create a corporate training session, or build a team development activity for workplace audiences.
Do NOT use for academic or K-12 workshops (use `workshop-design`), for full course design (use `online-course-design`), or for conference presentations (not an education skill).
